lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: You are coming with me right now, Harper, or I pull this trigger and end my half-brother Cole forever!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: You are insane, Jake, your own mother Diane murdered your grandmother Evelyn for this shipping empire!

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: I do not care about the ledger, I only care about you!

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Put the gun down, Jake, do not ruin your future for this wretched night-shift nurse!

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Shut up, Mother, you started this mess by poisoning the matriarch!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Look at him, Jake, your mother is using you as a shield just like she used everyone else!

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Silence, Harper, choose me or watch Cole bleed out in cuffs!

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Listen to me, Detective, that crooked arrest is a mistake because I am Cole Whitmore, the rightful CEO!

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Save it for the station house, Hayes, you are trespassing and interfering with a homicide investigation.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: My injured body is failing me, but I will break these gates down before I let Jake take my wife!
